description: This file contains the implementation of the MetadataGenerator class which is responsible for generating metadata configuration code for the Orleans serialization system. It references metadata models, code generation patterns, and builds a syntax tree for configuration setup including serializers, copiers, converters, proxies, interfaces, activators, type IDs, and aliases.

classes.name: MetadataGenerator
classes.description: Responsible for generating the metadata configuration class syntax for Orleans serialization, including registration of serializers, copiers, proxies, interfaces, activators, type IDs, and aliases based on the metadata model.

methods.name: GenerateMetadata
methods.description: Creates a class declaration syntax that configures metadata-related information for Orleans serialization, adding registration calls for types, proxies, interfaces, activators, and other metadata.

methods.name: AddCompoundTypeAliases
methods.description: Recursively constructs code statements to build a nested tree of type alias mappings for use in metadata configuration.

methods.name: GetCodecTypeName
methods.description: Returns the TypeSyntax for the serializer codec of a given type description.

methods.name: GetCopierTypeName
methods.description: Returns the TypeSyntax for the copier of a given type description.

methods.name: GetActivatorTypeName
methods.description: Returns the TypeSyntax for the activator of a given type description.
